entities.summary: Charles Henry John Benedict Crofton Chetwynd Chetwynd-Talbot, 22nd Earl of Shrewsbury, styled Viscount Ingestre until 1980, is an English aristocrat. He is the premier earl in the Peerage of England as the Earl of Shrewsbury. He also holds the titles of Earl of Waterford, Earl Talbot and Baron Talbot.
